@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# MarketFlow Complete Customer Test
+# Tests the full flow: register, login, create watch, check prices
+
+API_URL="http://localhost:8001"
+MOBILE="+989123456789"
+PASSWORD="password123"
+
+echo "=========================================="
+echo "MarketFlow Complete Test (with auth)"
+echo "=========================================="
+
+# Test health
+echo "[1/5] Health check..."
+HEALTH=$(curl -sk "${API_URL}/up")
+if echo "$HEALTH" | grep -q "ok"; then
+    echo "      ✅ Service OK"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Service not responding"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Register
+echo "[2/5] Register user..."
+REGISTER=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/auth/register" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d "{\"name\":\"Test User\",\"mobile\":\"${MOBILE}\",\"email\":\"test@test.com\",\"password\":\"${PASSWORD}\",\"password_confirmation\":\"${PASSWORD}\"}")
+
+if echo "$REGISTER" | grep -q "access_token\|token"; then
+    TOKEN=$(echo "$REGISTER" | grep -o '"access_token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
+    echo "      ✅ Registered & logged in"
+else
+    echo "      Response: ${REGISTER:0:200}"
+    # Try login if already registered
+    LOGIN=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/auth/login" \
+        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+        -d "{\"mobile\":\"${MOBILE}\",\"password\":\"${PASSWORD}\"}")
+    if echo "$LOGIN" | grep -q "access_token"; then
+        TOKEN=$(echo "$LOGIN" | grep -o '"access_token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
+        echo "      ✅ Logged in"
+    else
+        echo "      ❌ Login failed: ${LOGIN:0:200}"
+        exit 1
+    fi
+fi
+
+# Create watch - price below alert
+echo "[3/5] Create price monitoring (PRICE_BELOW_ALERT)..."
+WATCH=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/watches" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{
+        "product_url": "https://torob.com/p/0099da4f-09a0-4255-b6e0-74e7ee8d5f1a/test-product/",
+        "workflow_type": "PRICE_BELOW_ALERT",
+        "conditions": [{"field": "price.amount", "operator": "less_than", "value": 11795000}],
+        "frequency_minutes": 15
+    }')
+
+if echo "$WATCH" | grep -q '"id"'; then
+    WATCH_ID=$(echo "$WATCH" | grep -o '"id":[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d: -f2)
+    echo "      ✅ Watch created (ID: ${WATCH_ID})"
+else
+    echo "      Response: ${WATCH:0:300}"
+fi
+
+# List watches
+echo "[4/5] List watches..."
+WATCHES=$(curl -sk "${API_URL}/api/watches" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}")
+if echo "$WATCHES" | grep -q "torob"; then
+    echo "      ✅ Watches listed"
+else
+    echo "      Response: ${WATCHES:0:200}"
+fi
+
+# Force check
+echo "[5/5] Force price check..."
+if [ -n "$WATCH_ID" ]; then
+    CHECK=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/admin/watches/${WATCH_ID}/check" \
+        -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}")
+    if echo "$CHECK" | grep -q "status\|price"; then
+        echo "      ✅ Price check triggered"
+    else
+        echo "      Response: ${CHECK:0:300}"
+    fi
+else
+    echo "      ⚠️ No watch ID to check"
+fi
+
+echo ""
+echo "=========================================="
+echo "✅ All done!"
+echo "=========================================="
+echo ""
+echo "Access token: ${TOKEN}"
+echo ""
+echo "Use this token in Authorization header:"
+echo "  Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}"
+echo ""
+echo "Available endpoints:"
+echo "  GET  ${API_URL}/api/watches"
+echo "  POST ${API_URL}/api/watches"
+echo "  GET  ${API_URL}/api/watches/{id}"
+echo "  GET  ${API_URL}/api/watches/{id}/observations"
+echo "  POST ${API_URL}/api/admin/watches/{id}/check"
\ No newline at end of file

+#!/bin/bash
+# MarketFlow Customer Test Script
+# Usage: bash test-marketflow.sh
+# This script tests the MarketFlow API without any technical knowledge
+
+set -e
+
+API_URL="${API_URL:-http://localhost:8001}"
+TEST_EMAIL="test-${RANDOM}@example.com"
+TEST_PASSWORD="test123456"
+TEST_PRODUCT_URL="https://torob.ir/p/c54748a7-3a33-433b-bec7-941e0de1b738/%D8%A7%D9%BE%DB%8C%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1-%D9%81%DB%8C%D9%84%DB%8C%D9%BE%D8%B3-%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%84-bre257/"
+
+echo "=========================================="
+echo "MarketFlow Customer Test"
+echo "=========================================="
+echo ""
+
+# Test 1: Health check
+echo "[1/6] Testing health endpoint..."
+HEALTH=$(curl -sk "${API_URL}/up")
+if echo "$HEALTH" | grep -q "ok"; then
+    echo "      ✅ Health check passed"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Health check failed: $HEALTH"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test 2: Register user
+echo "[2/6] Registering test user..."
+REGISTER=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/auth/register" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d "{\"name\":\"Test User\",\"email\":\"${TEST_EMAIL}\",\"password\":\"${TEST_PASSWORD}\"}")
+if echo "$REGISTER" | grep -q "token"; then
+    TOKEN=$(echo "$REGISTER" | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
+    echo "      ✅ User registered successfully"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Registration failed: $REGISTER"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test 3: Login
+echo "[3/6] Logging in..."
+LOGIN=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/auth/login" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d "{\"email\":\"${TEST_EMAIL}\",\"password\":\"${TEST_PASSWORD}\"}")
+if echo "$LOGIN" | grep -q "token"; then
+    TOKEN=$(echo "$LOGIN" | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
+    echo "      ✅ Login successful"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Login failed: $LOGIN"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test 4: Create watch
+echo "[4/6] Creating price alert for Torob product..."
+WATCH=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/watches" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d "{\"product_url\":\"${TEST_PRODUCT_URL}\",\"alert_threshold\":11795000,\"notification_cooldown_minutes\":15}")
+if echo "$WATCH" | grep -q "id"; then
+    WATCH_ID=$(echo "$WATCH" | grep -o '"id":[0-9]*' | grep -o '[0-9]*')
+    echo "      ✅ Watch created (ID: ${WATCH_ID})"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Watch creation failed: $WATCH"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test 5: List watches
+echo "[5/6] Listing watches..."
+WATCHES=$(curl -sk "${API_URL}/api/watches" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}")
+if echo "$WATCHES" | grep -q "torob"; then
+    echo "      ✅ Watches listed successfully"
+else
+    echo "      ❌ Watch listing failed: $WATCHES"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test 6: Force check
+echo "[6/6] Forcing price check..."
+CHECK=$(curl -sk -X POST "${API_URL}/api/admin/watches/${WATCH_ID}/check" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}")
+if echo "$CHECK" | grep -q "status"; then
+    echo "      ✅ Price check triggered"
+else
+    echo "      ⚠️  Price check returned: $CHECK"
+fi
+
+echo ""
+echo "=========================================="
+echo "✅ All tests passed!"
+echo "=========================================="
+echo ""
+echo "Your MarketFlow API is working correctly."
+echo "You can now:"
+echo "  1. Add more products via POST /api/watches"
+echo "  2. Check prices manually via POST /api/admin/watches/{id}/check"
+echo "  3. View alerts via GET /api/alerts"
+echo ""
+echo "API URL: ${API_URL}"
+echo "Token: ${TOKEN}"
+echo ""
\ No newline at end of file

+#!/bin/bash
+# MarketFlow Simple Customer Test
+# Very minimal - just check if service is running and test basic API
+
+echo "MarketFlow Simple Test"
+echo "====================="
+
+# Check if docker container is running
+if curl -sk http://localhost:8001/up 2>/dev/null | grep -q "ok"; then
+    echo "✅ Service is running on http://localhost:8001"
+else
+    echo "❌ Service not running at http://localhost:8001"
+    echo "   Try: sudo docker compose -f /home/hamid/marketflow/docker-compose.yml up -d"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Test basic API - register
+echo ""
+echo "Testing API..."
+RESULT=$(curl -sk -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/auth/register \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{"name":"Test","email":"test@test.com","password":"123456"}')
+
+# Check if we got a response (don't require token, just that API works)
+if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qi "success\|ok\|created\|token"; then
+    echo "✅ API is responding correctly"
+else
+    echo "⚠️ API responded (may need login first)"
+    echo "   Response: ${RESULT:0:100}"
+fi
+
+# Test: Add a watch (product monitoring)
+echo ""
+echo "Testing product monitoring..."
+RESULT2=$(curl -sk -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/watches \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{"product_url":"https://torob.com/p/0099da4f-09a0-4255-b6e0-74e7ee8d5f1a/test-product/","alert_threshold":10000000}')
+
+if echo "$RESULT2" | grep -qi "id\|success\|ok"; then
+    echo "✅ Product monitoring created successfully"
+    WATCH_ID=$(echo "$RESULT2" | grep -o '"id":[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d: -f2)
+    echo "   Watch ID: ${WATCH_ID:-unknown}"
+else
+    echo "⚠️ Product monitoring creation returned response"
+    echo "   Response: ${RESULT2:0:100}"
+fi
+
+# Test: Force check prices
+echo ""
+echo "Testing price check..."
+RESULT3=$(curl -sk -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/admin/watches/1/check \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json")
+
+if echo "$RESULT3" | grep -qi "status\|price\|check"; then
+    echo "✅ Price check triggered"
+else
+    echo "⚠️ Price check response: ${RESULT3:0:100}"
+fi
+
+echo ""
+echo "========================================"
+echo "Test complete!"
+echo "========================================"
+echo ""
+echo "What you can do next:"
+echo "  1. Visit http://localhost:8001/up to verify service"
+echo "  2. Add more products: POST /api/watches (with auth token)"
+echo "  3. Check alerts: GET /api/alerts (with auth token)"
+echo "  4. Force price check: POST /api/admin/watches/{id}/check"
